title: Finn the Brave Little Fox and the Whispering Bridge
title_fr: Finn le Petit Renard Courageux et le Pont des Murmures
character: Finn, a little red fox cub with a sky-blue scarf
moral: True bravery means helping a friend even when you feel scared.

title: Bramble and the Magic Acorn: A Tale of Sharing
title_fr: Bramble et le Gland Magique: Une Histoire de Partage
character: Bramble, a tiny chubby brown hedgehog with soft spiky quills, big curious emerald-green eyes, tiny pink nose, wearing a cozy yellow knitted vest with shiny brass buttons
moral: Sharing your treats with others brings true happiness.

title: Pip and the Glowing Cloud
character: Pip, a tiny fuzzy purple koala with soft round ears, bright amber-brown eyes, a cute black button nose, wearing a cozy teal-blue poncho with silver snowflake patterns
moral: Helping others brings the brightest joy to your own heart.

title: Kip and the Singing Starfruit
character: Kip, a tiny chubby striped orange badger with soft fluffy fur, big round emerald-green eyes, a cute black nose, wearing a cozy mint-green waistcoat with shiny wooden buttons
moral: True kindness is helping others shine their brightest.

title: Barnaby and the Whispering Windmill
title_fr: Barnaby et le Moulin qui Chuchote
character: Barnaby, a fluffy chubby baby raccoon with soft gray-and-white striped fur, big curious dark-brown eyes, cute round ears, wearing a bright orange canvas apron with two big pockets
moral: Patience and steady work bring the sweetest rewards.

title: Toby the Little Otter and the Gentle Breeze
title_fr: Toby la Petite Loutre et la Brise Douce
character: Toby, a tiny chubby baby river otter with velvety chocolate-brown fur, a creamy white belly, sparkling honey-golden eyes, a cute black button nose, wearing a cozy sunshine-yellow hooded rain jacket with two little blueberry-blue patch pockets
moral: Patience and gentle kindness can heal any trouble.

title: Milo the Tiny Turtle and the Magic Pebble
title_fr: Milo la Petite Tortue et le Galet Magique
character: Milo, a tiny chubby baby sea turtle with smooth emerald-green skin, a patterned golden-brown shell, big curious deep-violet eyes, wearing a tiny navy-blue sailor hat with a small white anchor emblem.
moral: Being patient helps you achieve your biggest dreams.

title: Zuzu the Little Panda and the Magic Bamboo
title_fr: Zuzu le Petit Panda et le Bambou Magique
character: Zuzu, a tiny chubby baby panda with soft black-and-white fluffy fur, big curious emerald-green eyes, black patches around the eyes, a tiny pink nose, wearing a cozy raspberry-red puffer vest with shiny silver snaps
moral: True friendship is more valuable than keeping treasures all to yourself.

title: Penny the Little Pika and the Quiet Song
title_fr: Penny la Petite Pika et le Chant Doux
character: Penny, a tiny chubby round pika with fluffy cinnamon-brown fur, soft cream-colored round ears, big sparkling sapphire-blue eyes, a tiny twitchy pink nose, wearing a cozy bright-coral fleece jacket with shiny lemon-yellow toggles.
moral: Listening quietly with love can comfort a friend better than loud words.

title: Jojo the Little Owl and the Lost Echo
title_fr: Jojo le Petit Hibou et l'Écho Perdu
character: Jojo, a tiny chubby baby owl with soft fluffy lavender-gray feathers, big round golden-yellow eyes, a tiny curved orange beak, wearing a cozy lime-green scarf with soft fringed ends
moral: Speaking kind words creates happiness all around you.

title: Gigi the Little Sugar Glider's Big Leap
title_fr: Le Grand Saut de Gigi le Petit Planeur
character: Gigi, a tiny chubby baby sugar glider with soft velvety silver-blue fur, a creamy marshmallow-white belly, big round sparkling amber-brown eyes, soft round pink ears, and tiny paws, wearing a bright mustard-yellow quilted capelet fastened with a single shiny cherry-red button.
moral: Believing in yourself starts with one small, brave hop.
